title: ModelVersionRecord
description: Archivum-anchored, prime-indexed record of a model promotion event within the AHGI governance lattice. Every model version transition in a healthcare-tagged deployment must produce one of these records before the promoted model may serve inference.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must match enforcing runtime version exactly.

record_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this model version record.

prime_index.description: Prime number assigned by Archivum under namespace ahgi.model_version. Uniquely indexes this promotion event in the PIRTM lineage.

namespace.description: Archivum namespace partition. Must be ahgi.model_version for this record class.

model.description: Static identity and integrity block for the promoted model artifact.

model_id.description: Stable identifier for the model lineage. Shared across all versions of the same model. Distinct from record_id.

version_tag.description: Semantic version tag for this promotion, e.g. v1.4.2 or v2.0.0-rc1.

training_data_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hash of the training dataset manifest. Not the data itself — the manifest listing dataset IDs, versions, and consent tensor prime indices that authorized training use.

weights_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the serialized model weights artifact at promotion time.

framework.description: ML framework used to produce the model artifact.

healthcare_classification.description: Healthcare governance classification for this model.

risk_tier.description: Clinical risk tier. Tier 3 and above require coherence gate enforcement and spectral drift sentinel binding. Tier 4 additionally requires Governance Judiciary pre-approval.

phi_exposure.description: True if this model processes PHI at inference time. Triggers mandatory consent tensor pre-flight for all inference calls.

agent_classes_authorized.description: Agent classes permitted to invoke this model. Runtime enforces this list as a hard gate.

fda_pccp_applicable.description: True if this model falls under an FDA Predetermined Change Control Plan. Requires pccp_reference field.

pccp_reference.description: Reference identifier for the applicable FDA PCCP document. Required when fda_pccp_applicable is true.

promotion.description: Governance record of the promotion event itself.

promoted_at.description: Timestamp of promotion gate passage. Model is not live before this timestamp.

promoted_by_did.description: DID of the agent or human operator that triggered promotion. Must be a governance-registered principal.

from_version_prime_index.description: Prime index of the model version record this promotion supersedes. Enables rollback tracing. Use 2 for first-ever promotion of a model lineage.

promotion_type.description: Classification of the promotion event. emergency_override requires Governance Judiciary co-signature in approval_chain.

target_environment.description: Environment receiving the promoted model. Production and clinical_pilot require full certification block.

approval_chain.description: Ordered list of approvals required and obtained for this promotion. All required approvals must be present before Archivum anchoring.

approval_signature.description: Ed25519 or JWS signature by approver_did over (record_id + weights_hash + promoted_at).

conditions.description: Optional conditions attached to this approval, e.g. 'valid for clinical_pilot only, re-approval required for production'.

certification.description: The four AHGI mathematical certification domains. All four must pass for production or clinical_pilot promotion.

certified.description: True only if bounded output and convergence properties are confirmed by the method below.

method.description: Certification method used. lyapunov_analytic is strongest; empirical_bounded is weakest and requires explicit regulatory justification.

r_min.description: Coherence floor R_min used during certification testing. Must match or exceed system-wide R_min in coherence gate config.

lyapunov_bound.description: Certified Lyapunov upper bound on output norm. Inference outputs exceeding this bound trigger automatic coherence gate suppression.

certification_report_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the full stability certification report artifact.

provenance.description: Provenance certification — confirms model produces traceable, explainable outputs.

trace_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of inference paths in test suite that produced verifiable prime-indexed provenance receipts. Must be 100.0 for production promotion.

explainability_receipt_type.description: Explainability method bound to this model's output layer. 'none' is not permitted for tier_3 or tier_4 models.

phi_isolation_verified.description: True if provenance receipts have been verified to contain no raw PHI. Required when phi_exposure is true.

ethical_constraints.description: Ethical constraint certification per ASD Echo-Braid CSL layers.

csl_gate_version.description: Version of the CSL runtime used in certification testing.

invariants_tested.description: L1-HC invariants exercised in the ethical constraint test suite. All six must appear for production promotion.

violations_detected.description: Number of invariant violations detected during testing. Must be 0 for certification to pass.

drift_baseline.description: Establishes spectral fingerprint baseline for this model version. Sentinel compares future production fingerprints against this baseline.

baseline_fingerprint_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the spectral fingerprint vector computed at certification time. This is the reference point for all subsequent drift comparisons.

drift_threshold.description: Cosine similarity delta above which drift sentinel triggers suspension of this model version. Recommended default: 0.1.

fingerprint_dimensions.description: Dimensionality of the spectral fingerprint vector. Must be consistent across all versions of the same model_id.

spectral_fingerprint.description: Compact spectral identity of this model version. Used by Spectral Drift Sentinel for runtime comparison.

vector_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the full spectral fingerprint vector. The vector itself is stored in Archivum; this hash is the governance binding.

layer_source.description: Model layer(s) from which the spectral fingerprint was extracted, e.g. 'encoder.final_hidden', 'all_attention_heads', 'output_logits'.

norm.description: L2 norm of the spectral fingerprint vector. Used as a fast pre-check before computing full cosine similarity.

archivum_vector_record_id.description: Archivum record ID where the full fingerprint vector is stored. Enables sentinel to retrieve full vector for comparison without embedding it in this record.

provenance.description: PIRTM provenance chain link under ahgi.model_version namespace.

parent_prime_index.description: Prime index of the immediately preceding model version record in this model lineage. Cross-references Archivum ahgi.model_version chain.

lineage_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the parent model version record as anchored in Archivum. Enables offline chain verification.

consent_tensor_prime_indices.description: Prime indices of ahgi.consent records that authorized the training data used to produce this model version. Closes the consent-to-model lineage loop.

archivum_record_id.description: Archivum's canonical record ID for this prime_index assignment and model version anchoring.

archivum_did.description: DID of the Archivum registry instance. Must match governance-registered Archivum DID.

anchor_timestamp.description: Timestamp of Archivum anchoring. Model promotion is not valid before this timestamp.

namespace.description: Archivum namespace partition confirming this record is anchored under ahgi.model_version.

signature.description: Linked Data Proof over the complete model version record, signed by the promoted_by_did principal.

verification_method.description: DID URL of the signing key.

proof_value.description: Base58 or JWS-encoded signature over the canonical record excluding this signature block.
